plugins.name: revenue-manager
plugins.description: Release candidate: adds the PriceLabs customization layer. Step 4c reads the six pricing rules (toggled-off included), shared profiles, actions, nudges and the PriceLabs change log through one reducer. Step 5.5 attributes an observed price to a layer before any lever is named. Step 8 gains a validated customization write path: snapshot, merge, range checks, send, mandatory echo check.

description: Solnest Revenue Manager: recommend-only STR pricing analysis with a PMS reconciliation gate, PriceLabs payload reducer, and a Supabase audit trail.
